notes.title: Don’t Look Up! The Pumpkinfall
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/1f8a13346e495e5a2b364af2db96afca5bf29e8f.jpg[/img]
[quote=author]
[h3][i]From the clouds, with a thunderous roar and a howling wind, an enormous bright-orange pumpkin plummeted and crashed near the headman's house. The earth trembled beneath its weight. It was so gigantic that it could have fed the entire village for weeks. Soon, cries of terror echoed from every direction.

The villagers rushed out of their homes, unable to believe their eyes. The pumpkin, split open like an ancient beast, as if torn from the bowels of the earth, suddenly cracked further. From its depths, as though drawn out by some abyss, emerged grotesque figures — faceless, with long, clawed limbs.

With a disgusting squelch, enormous spiders and beetles began to crawl out — black as pitch, their legs coated in thick slime. Their eyes, glowing like red embers, gleamed in the mist. They scurried in every direction, like a horde of ravenous predators. But that was only the beginning.

After them, human bones started to fly out of the pumpkin — not just scattered fragments, but entire skeletal hands and skulls, glimmering in the darkness. They twirled through the air in a grotesque dance of death. And behind them, as if emerging from the very pits of hell, coffins followed. Black, massive, covered in green mold and dirt, they whirled over the field, their lids slamming shut with a hollow thud.

But the most terrifying sight of all was the appearance of gigantic black clocks, entirely made from human skeletons. The hands on the clock face spun wildly, filling the air with a horrifying crunch, as if bones were breaking, pushing time mercilessly toward midnight. Instead of a chime, a menacing graveyard hum echoed, reverberating across the fields and forests, freezing the villagers in their tracks with fear.[/i][/h3]
[/quote]

[b]Pumpkin Strike[/b] is available in our game store during this spooky autumn season.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
	Main:
		- When preparing a network match for a long time, it was possible to rejoin the queue, which led to the player participating in two matches at the same time, although he controlled only the first one
		- If the time zone could not be determined, the game would not start
		- Fixed various network bugs that could lead to issues with reconnecting to the game
		
	Gameplay:
		- Sometimes a game state unsynchronization occurred when reconnecting to a match
		- Sometimes the system of determining the harm to an ally was falsely triggered
		- Small impassable areas of terrain could appear during combat
		- Bashibuzuk the elephant could attack terrain
		
	Replay viewing:
		- When rewinding a replay, the fog of war status was not updated
		- In replay view, when switching players, the chat always continued to show the first team's messages
		- When changing the replay speed, the fog of war animation did not change its speed
		- When rewinding a replay, sometimes there was an unsynchronization

	Interfaces:
		- In a private game on a custom map, team occupancy was not shown
		- Incorrect coloring of players in chat with initially selected coloring by teams
		- Factions scrolled incorrectly in the map editor
		- Relationships between teams were incorrectly shown in the map editor
		- When creating a private game, the name of the abstract country was missing
		- Fixed some localization errors
		
	Visual:
		- The animation of the rider's left attack was not looped, causing it to look jerky
		- The battle balloon was dropping from a high altitude when it appeared
		- Elephant with archers did not have visually rotated turrets
		- West Asia Tower had archers rotating in sync when idle
		- Reduced excessive volume of some battle music
		- There were very dark shadows on deep water
		- The decks of some of the ships were underwater
		- The eagle did not flap its wings often enough

	Other errors...

notes.title: Patch # 5. Graphics, Balloons and Store
notes.content:
We have revised the in-game graphics, greatly improving lighting, textures, detail and much more.
In addition to revising the game's graphics.
This patch adds brand new content including new upgrades, units and buildings throughout the Middle and Industrial Ages.
We continue to carefully read the forums and listen to community feedback to that end this patch contains significant changes to unit stats and map generation to improve balance.  
Units can be stopped with the stop button.
"Arsenal' upgrades renamed to "Armory".
